lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit a structured grid-like distribution with approximately 5-7 visible maxima per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a rectangular lattice pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side to lower-intensity shadows on the ventral side of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) are visible: one is attached at the posterior insertion of the pectoral fin, and at least two others are trailing in the water column ventral to the pectoral fin.
